name: Pitchit
description: Pitchit is an innovative AI-driven platform designed to enhance your pitching skills and presentations. It leverages advanced AI tools to provide feedback, suggestions, and improvements for your pitches, ensuring you deliver compelling and effective presentations every time.

events.d: Adds a new lead to Pitchit and assigns them to the selected campaign.

events.n: When a new pitch is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a new pitch is created in Pitchit.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a meeting is booked in the account.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever any lead's priority is changed.

events.n: When a lead's insights are updated
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever any lead's insights are updated in the account.
